refnamediv.refpurpose: Return the content of a cURL handle if CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER is set

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.returnvalues;
Return the content of a cURL handle if CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER is set or &null; if not set. The content is an empty string when no data has been received yet, and it includes the response headers if CURLOPT_HEADER is set.
After a multi transfer that fails partway, the bytes received so far are returned: check the result key of curl_multi_info_read to know whether the transfer completed. After a failed curl_exec, the content is an empty string.
The content is not cleared by curl_multi_remove_handle or curl_multi_close: it can be read until the handle is added to a multi handle or executed again.
